faq.title: Big Walk FAQ
faq.description: Common questions about Big Walk multiplayer, crossplay, platforms, and hosting.

items.question: Does Big Walk support crossplay?
items.answer: Yes. The official FAQ confirms that players on different systems can play together across Windows, Mac, PlayStation 5, and Nintendo Switch 2.

items.question: How do I join a friend's Big Walk game?
items.answer: Join the active friend game when it appears, or use the short Join Code generated by the host. Mac App Store players should use the code because Game Center is not supported.

items.question: Does Big Walk have random matchmaking?
items.answer: No. Big Walk is built around arranged groups rather than random matchmaking. Choose a host, invite your group, and use the in-game voice or text chat.

items.question: How many players can join Big Walk?
items.answer: Big Walk supports cooperative groups of 2 to 12 players according to the official game information.
